title: Full habitat site
description: The complete Blender scene: the two-deck habitat with its 3D-printed regolith shell, sintered foundation pad, landing pad with beacons, path lights and solar arrays, on lunar terrain (340 m across) with Earth on the horizon.

title: Habitat (color model)
description: The habitat on its own, without the terrain, with color materials for each system. This is the model used for the color 1:50 print.

title: 1:50 print parts
description: The six printable STL parts in one model, each in its own color: lower deck, upper deck, roof, regolith shield, crew EVA airlock and equipment airlock.

title: HUNCH Final Habitat
description: The final, largest version of the design: the central "kingdom" base with its hub tower, crew core and agriculture, medical, science, utility and logistics domes, plus five outlying EMPIRE bases about 500 m away, on baked lunar terrain with Earth in the sky. Simplified for the web from a 7.4-million-triangle Blender scene.

title: Lunar Smart Adaptive Habitat (baked)
description: The Lunar Smart Adaptive Habitat site with texture-baked materials (RICH_BAKED set).

title: Habitat base only (baked)
description: The habitat on its own with texture-baked color materials (RICH_BAKED set).

title: Crew Wellness Dome
description: The Crew Wellness Dome design with texture-baked materials (RICH_BAKED set): a domed habitat on a raised ring base with docking modules.

title: Hard-shelled habitat
description: The hard-shelled habitat concept with texture-baked materials (RICH_BAKED set), shown with a cutaway through its round shell.

title: Base 1
description: Base 1 design with texture-baked materials (RICH_BAKED set): a spread-out cluster of modules, domes and solar arrays.

title: Design 1
description: Habitat design concept 1 (RICH_BAKED set): a central domed complex with spires and greenhouse domes.

title: Design 2
description: Habitat design concept 2 (RICH_BAKED set): a long walled compound with a green inner ring and solar arrays.

title: Design 3
description: Habitat design concept 3 (RICH_BAKED set): a tall upright capsule habitat with solar panels.

title: Design 4
description: Habitat design concept 4 (RICH_BAKED set): a large round dome surrounded by modules, landers and solar arrays.

title: Design 5
description: Habitat design concept 5 (RICH_BAKED set): a row of connected rectangular modules with a dome and solar arrays.

title: Design models set
description: The "Models" collection from the RICH_BAKED set: individual habitat modules and equipment laid out side by side.

title: Project 1/2: HUNCH Lunar Base
description: The base from Game 2, the VR adventure where you command the crew, mine and survive storms: central hub and tower, crew core and the agriculture, utility, medical, science and logistics domes. Project 2 uses the same design 1.5x bigger.

title: Project 3: Moon Base Final
description: The Project 3 VR-simulator base on its 4.8 km terrain: core, four modules, six nodes, four sleep domes, hallways, landing pad, cargo lander, solar towers and comms mast.

title: Project 3: habitat only
description: The Project 3 base without the terrain, so the layout of modules, nodes, sleep domes and hallways is easy to see.

title: Adaptive Recovery Pod: Healthy
description: Sleep and recovery capsule. Green: the crew member is rested.

title: Adaptive Recovery Pod: Fatigue
description: Yellow: poor sleep detected. The AI shows its recommendations.

title: Adaptive Recovery Pod: Stress
description: Blue: calming light, Earth view and the counsellor hologram.

title: AI Psychological Monitoring Wristband
description: Heart rate, stress, sleep and a private mood ring on one band.

title: Personal Sanctuary Pod
description: A noise-cancelling retreat with a recliner, VR dock and holo-plants.

title: Modular Lunar Greenhouse
description: Four hydroponic towers, grow lights, water loop, O₂ module and an AI growth monitor.

title: Smart Medical Scanner Bay
description: A realistic CMO station: scan arch, hydraulic chair, vitals monitor, AED, ultrasound, O₂ and IV.

title: AI Companion Hologram Projector
description: A round table that projects a virtual counsellor for check-ins.

title: Adaptive Circadian Lighting
description: A bedside sunrise lamp and under-bunk strip that keep the body clock on Earth time.

title: Emotional Support Garden
description: Flower beds, a bench, a water station and an AI planting arm.

title: ECLSS Core
description: CO₂ scrubbers, oxygen generation, water recovery and the life-support display.

title: Oxygen Tank Rack
description: Four high-pressure O₂ cylinders with regulators, gauges and a manifold.

title: AI Health Detection System
description: The on-board computer and dashboard that score the six conditions.

title: Mood Health Tracker
description: A two-tap mood check-in panel with a 14-day trend and a crew tablet.

title: Heart-Rate & Vitals Monitor
description: A rolling bedside monitor with ECG, pleth, respiration, a chest strap and a finger clip.

title: Blood-Pressure Tracker
description: A wall-mounted automatic cuff with display, coiled hose and arm rest.

title: AI Sleep-Detection Bed
description: A realistic crew bed with under-mattress sensing and sleep software on the headboard.

title: Emergency Mental Health Station
description: A 24/7 private line to Earth, a breathing guide and a comfort kit.

title: Biometrics Sensor Array
description: A wall of camera, microphone, CO₂, temperature, UWB and radiation sensor tiles.

title: Virtual Earth Window
description: A high-brightness panel with a live Earth view and nature scenes.

title: Autonomous Maintenance Drone
description: A ducted-fan inspection drone with tool arms, dust brush and a charging dock.

title: Smart Habitat Control Console
description: Three screens: crew mood, habitat health and 7-day trends.

title: Stress Recovery Lounge
description: A curved sofa, warm ring light, low table, plants and a nature screen.

title: Crew Health Station
description: The medical bay kiosk for a daily 2-minute check-in: ECG, blood pressure, SpO₂ and temperature.

title: Crew beacon (chest)
description: A chest-worn beacon that tracks heart rate and heart-rate variability; low HRV is an early sign of rising stress.

title: Cortisol patch
description: A tiny microneedle sweat patch that measures cortisol, the body's stress hormone, and compares the morning peak with the wearer's own baseline.

title: Night wristband
description: Worn at night to track sleep: how long, how deep, and how often you wake up.

title: Smart sleep bunk
description: The bed in each private sleep pod: a sensor strip under the mattress and a circadian mood light.

title: Zone sensor pod
description: Mounted on the ceiling of every zone: watches the air, and in shared rooms only, voices and faces.

title: Dust Decontamination Airlock
description: EVAs start and end here. Lunar dust irritated Apollo crews' eyes and lungs and wore down seals; suitports and dust removal are NASA's fixes.

title: ECLSS racks + Circadian Lighting Wall
description: CO₂ removal, O₂ generation and water recovery as on the ISS, next to a lighting wall that protects the crew's sleep.

title: Exercise Bay
description: Daily exercise against bone and muscle loss, modelled on the ISS treadmill, bike and resistance machine.

title: Habitat shell modular kit
description: Every wall, floor, ceiling, door, cable tray, handrail and sensor used to build the LUNA VR habitat.

title: Hygiene
description: Hygiene and water recovery, with no voice or camera sensors to respect crew privacy.

title: Maintenance Robot Bay + Stores
description: Spares and stowage far from resupply; repairs use real parts and the robots are dispatched from here.

title: Medical bay + Water-wall Storm Shelter
description: Medical care far from Earth, using water as radiation shielding; everyone shelters here during a solar flare.

title: Mood Check-in Kiosk
description: A touch screen inside an acoustic privacy booth for the daily 1–5 mood check-in, which keeps the AI honest when sensors fail.

title: Ops: Digital Twin + LUNA compute
description: Digital twin table, trend and forecast wall, emergency console and the LUNA compute rack: the AI advises, humans decide.

title: Pressurised rover
description: A rover for long surface traverses with suitport entry.

title: Reconfigurable Social Hub
description: Shared meals, movie nights and a partition to split the room when two crew members need space.

title: Six-legged repair robot
description: Based on NASA JPL's six-limbed ATHLETE robot; it cleans dust off the solar arrays.

title: Crew Pod
description: A private crew sleeping pod from the LUNA VR habitat.

title: Greenhouse Therapy Racks
description: Plant-growing racks from the LUNA VR habitat greenhouse.

title: LUNA-X AI Command Center
description: Detailed LUNA-X model of the AI command center.

title: LUNA-X Airlock
description: Detailed LUNA-X model of the airlock.

title: LUNA-X Sleep Pod
description: Detailed LUNA-X model of a crew sleep pod.

title: LUNA-X Wellness Dock
description: Detailed LUNA-X model of the wellness dock.

title: Project 3 Big Board (1:100)
description: The big presentation model that fills a 2 ft board: removable roofs, room inserts, regolith shields and a rover, with every part in its real position.

title: Project 3 Moon Base kit (1:150)
description: The closed-set print kit that matches the VR game: core, four modules, six nodes, four sleep domes and hallways. Shown as a parts layout.

title: Project 1/2 base kit (1:150)
description: Central hub and tower, crew core, agriculture/utility/medical/science/logistics domes, junction nodes and tunnels. Project 2 prints the same parts at 1:225. Shown as a parts layout.

title: Display extras (1:700)
description: Display pieces from the Project 1/2 world: rocket, landing pad, satellite tower, the giant glass "kingdom" dome and the whole Project 1 base as one mini piece. Shown as a parts layout.

title: Fluids module
description: Engineering model of the fluids system: utility floor, supply and return piping and a hydroponic grow chamber.

title: Food module
description: Engineering model of food production: greenhouse floor with hydroponic and aquaponic piping and grow beds.

title: Radiation module
description: Engineering model of radiation protection: a pressure shell wrapped in a water jacket, polyethylene and a regolith berm.
